origin.description: Estimate the Kullback-Leibler divergence of sample X from sample Y.
origin.details: The result is a vector of length k. A zero distance contributes -Inf.
origin.example: KL.divergence of the first six rows and the last six rows, k=2

translation.description: KL_divergence is log(m/n) plus the dimension times the difference of mean log neighbor distances.
translation.details: The result is a vector of length k. A zero distance contributes -Inf.
translation.example: KL.divergence of the first six rows and the last six rows, k=2
